description: Frontend: Complete Profile page overhaul with avatar upload (drag-and-drop + file picker), editable email with password confirmation, enhanced password change form with strength validation, and navbar avatar display. Uses base64 encoding to send avatar to backend without needing multipart/form-data.
steps: 1. Create a reusable AvatarUpload component at frontend/src/components/ui/AvatarUpload.jsx: (a) Circular display area showing current avatar image or initials fallback. (b) Drag-and-drop zone with visual feedback (border highlight on dragover). (c) Click to open file picker (accept='.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.webp'). (d) Client-side validation: max 5MB, allowed MIME types only. (e) On file select: read as base64 data URL using FileReader, show instant preview. (f) Props: currentAvatar (string|null), initials (string), onAvatarChange (callback with base64 string), disabled (boolean). (g) Show loading spinner overlay when disabled. (h) Style with Tailwind - modern rounded component with hover/focus states.

2. Update frontend/src/services/auth.service.js: Add new API methods mapping to the new /api/profile endpoints: (a) getProfileFromProfileEndpoint: GET /profile. (b) updateProfileDetails: PUT /profile (name, organization). (c) changeEmail: PUT /profile/email (email, currentPassword). (d) changePassword: PUT /profile/password (currentPassword, newPassword, confirmPassword). (e) uploadAvatar: POST /profile/avatar (avatar base64 string). Keep existing /api/auth/profile methods for backward compat.

3. Rewrite frontend/src/pages/Profile.jsx with the following sections: (a) Top card: AvatarUpload component with user initials fallback, user name, email, role badge. Upload avatar calls the uploadAvatar service, on success calls updateProfile in AuthContext to refresh user state. (b) Account details form: Full Name (editable), Organization (editable), Save button with loading state. Uses PUT /profile. (c) Change Email form (new section): Email input (editable, with current email pre-filled), Current Password input (required for email change), Save Email button. Validates email format on client side. Shows error if duplicate. Uses PUT /profile/email. (d) Change Password form (enhanced): Current Password, New Password with strength indicator (shows requirements: 8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special char - each requirement shows green check or red x as user types), Confirm Password (shows match/mismatch indicator), Update Password button. Uses PUT /profile/password. (e) All forms: disable submit button while saving (show Spinner), show success toast on success, show error toast on failure. (f) Responsive grid layout: single column on mobile, two columns on lg screens.

4. Update frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx: Ensure the updateProfile callback can handle partial user updates (it already does via setUser). Add an 'updateAvatar' convenience method that calls the avatar upload endpoint and updates the user state with the returned user object.

5. Update frontend/src/components/layout/Navbar.jsx: Replace the initials-only avatar circle with a conditional: if user.avatarUrl exists and is truthy, render an tag with the avatarUrl as src (works for both URLs and base64 data URLs) inside the same rounded-full container. If no avatarUrl, fall back to the existing initials display. Apply object-cover and rounded-full classes to the img.
6. Update the profile page top card similarly: show with avatar if available, otherwise initials in the 16x16 circle.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/components/ui/AvatarUpload.jsx exists as a reusable drag-and-drop avatar upload component
The Profile page has four distinct sections: avatar+info card, account details form, change email form, change password form
The email field is editable and requires current password to change
The password form shows real-time strength validation indicators for each requirement
The confirm password field shows a match/mismatch indicator
All forms show loading spinners when submitting and are disabled during submission
The Navbar shows the user avatar image when avatarUrl is set, initials otherwise
The avatar upload shows instant preview before saving
Success and error notifications use the existing useNotification hook (notify.success/notify.error)
The frontend auth service has new methods for the /api/profile endpoints
verification: Read all created/modified frontend files and verify valid JSX syntax
Verify imports are consistent and reference existing modules correctly
Verify Tailwind classes used are standard utility classes
findings: All frontend changes implemented and verified via code review. Network restrictions prevent running npm/vite build or tests. The Profile page now has 4 distinct sections (avatar card, account details, change email, change password). The AvatarUpload component is fully reusable with drag-and-drop support. The Navbar conditionally renders an img tag when user.avatarUrl is truthy. AuthContext exposes updateAvatar method. Auth service has 5 new /api/profile endpoint methods.
